title: There Was a Man named Mr. Lang
transcription:
There was a Man Named Mr. Lang
(Auld Lang Syne)

There was a man named Mr. Lang,
who had a neon sign,
Now, Mr. Lang was very old,
so they called it: "Old Lang's sign."
For Old Lang's sign, my dear,
for Old Lang's sign!
Now, Mr. Lang was very old,
so they called it: "Old Lang's sign."
